authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan sources, focusing on underetymologised and smaller sources first for greater diversity. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have unlimited time now

proposals.evidence: Buddruss p28 item50 explicitly derives Grangali ṣūr from *śrun-, compares the Ashokan śruṇeyu type and insists on the source retroflex sibilant. Turner12598 directly gives Ningalam šuni and Shumashti šūne. The prefixless hear family is selected, not āśṛṇoti1460; source r and sibilants remain unchanged. Existing manual source collation and source image checked; no transcription or identity repair.
